g.text: ATMOSPHERIC COLUMN C-101, PUMPAROUNDS & SIDE STRIPPERS
1. C-101 trays numbered top-down. Pumparound heat recovered in preheat trains (PFD-001/002).
2. Side-stripper draw rates (FIC-1050/1060/1070) set cut points; product rate on stripper level.
3. Stripping steam is LP steam superheated in H-101 convection (stream 20).
4. Stream numbers (diamonds) refer to H&MB CFU-000-PR-HMB-001; data from design case, normal operation.
5. Pressures bar(g) unless noted. Pumps A/B are 2 x 100 %; only duty pump shown.
ID 6.9 m / 3.5 m strip. x 37.0 m T/T
